fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. A long winery driveway runs off Hopewell Road NW (set back, screened by trees/hedgerow with winery signs at the road) to the parking lot and building; no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint visible.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere on the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long driveway from Hopewell Road NW past the parking lot to the building cluster, with paved aprons around the building — easily holds 3+ vehicles.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Winery production building. No bank of dedicated freight dock doors. The south end has a covered crush-pad structure and an at-grade service apron; ~2-4 service/roll-up doors estimated. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls with parked trailers.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two distinct structures: the main winery production building and a smaller separate building to the NW with its own paved apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Eola-Amity Hills (Willamette Valley) — winery surrounded by estate vineyards and farmland on a rural two-lane road, well outside Salem's urban fabric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural farmland setting away from town; cellular coverage may be moderate. Medium confidence — flagged.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
